headline: Sensex Rebounds 990 Points to Settle Above 25,500 as Auto and FMCG Stocks Rally

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Indian equities staged a strong recovery after an initial flat start driven by US Fed rate hike concerns.
Nifty Auto index surged 4% and Nifty FMCG snapped its two-day losing streak to boost sentiment.
Nifty Bank traded near new record highs, supporting the broader market rebound.
Selling pressure in IT and metal stocks during early trade subsided as buying momentum accelerated.
whatHappening: Sensex surged 990 points while Nifty settled at 25,514 after opening muted.
PM Modi addressed India Inc regarding employment, higher wages, quality standards, and FTA planning.
Tata Technologies announced plans to double its revenue by $1.3 billion by 2030.
Razorpay is preparing to file for its Indian initial public offering as early as next week.
summary: Indian benchmark indices rebounded sharply, with the Sensex rising nearly 1,000 points and Nifty finishing above 25,500. The rally was spearheaded by strong gains in auto and FMCG sectors following early caution over Fed rate policy. Corporate highlights included Tata Technologies setting ambitious growth targets and Razorpay advancing its IPO plans.
